description: DeploymentSchedulingConfiguration composes the reusable scheduling building blocks from scheduling.k8s.io for use on a Deployment.

disruptionMode.description: disruptionMode defines the mode in which the Deployment's pods can be disrupted. One of Single or All. If omitted, standard per-pod disruption behavior is used. The All mode requires a gang schedulingPolicy. disruptionMode affects scheduler preemption only. It does not affect eviction or PodDisruptionBudgets.

resourceClaims.description: resourceClaims defines which ResourceClaims may be shared among Pods in the Deployment. Pods consume the devices allocated to a PodGroup's claim by defining a claim in its own Spec.ResourceClaims that matches the PodGroup's claim exactly. The claim must have the same name and refer to the same ResourceClaim or ResourceClaimTemplate. At most 4 claims may be set, matching the limit on the resulting PodGroup.

schedulingConstraints.description: schedulingConstraints defines optional scheduling constraints (e.g. topology) for the Deployment's pods.

schedulingPolicy.description: schedulingPolicy defines the scheduling policy for this Deployment. If spec.scheduling.schedulingPolicy is omitted, the Basic policy is used. Otherwise, exactly one of Basic or Gang must be set. For Gang, minCount may be omitted to derive it from replicas.
